stories.title: Judge throws out $1-million fine against N.B. seafood company, requests new decision
stories.summary: A federal judge has thrown out a $1-million fine and foreign worker ban against a New Brunswick seafood processing company.

stories.title: Hope for restart grows as Nackawic, N.B. feels effects of mill shutdown
stories.summary: Nearly three weeks after the Nackawic pulp mill shut down in New Brunswick, putting 350 workers out of work, the ripple effects are now reaching local businesses.

stories.title: Remains of N.B. sailor recovered nearly 80 years after plane crash
stories.summary: Nearly 80 years after a two-seat naval fighter crashed in Northern Ireland, the remains of a young man from New Brunswick have been recovered and identified.

stories.title: Weather alerts in effect due to heavy rain across N.S. and parts of N.B., N.L.
stories.summary: Heavy rain is set to hit Nova Scotia and much of New Brunswick and Newfoundland.

stories.title: N.B. government in talks with Quebec firm about restarting idled Nackawic pulp mill
stories.summary: Provincial Natural Resources Minister John Herron issued a statement Friday saying government officials are talking to Arbec Forest Products Inc., based in Saint-Léonard, Que.

stories.title: No criminality suspected after preterm fetus found in Fredericton airport washroom: RCMP
stories.summary: Police say they're investigating the circumstances surrounding the discovery of the remains and provided no further details.

stories.title: New Brunswick adopts HPV testing for cervical cancer, Nova Scotia urged to follow
stories.summary: Nova Scotia's Official Opposition is calling on the province to quickly adopt HPV testing for cervical cancer and transition away from the traditional Pap test.

stories.title: New Brunswick latest province to bring in ground rules for data centre projects
stories.summary: The New Brunswick government is bringing in a new set of ground rules for data centre projects, but critics question whether they go far enough.

stories.title: Driver ticketed after transport truck gets stuck under Fredericton bridge
stories.summary: The driver of a transport truck was ticketed Wednesday after the vehicle became lodged under a walking bridge in Fredericton.

stories.title: Scientists find possible explanation for North Atlantic right whales’ low birth rates
stories.summary: Scientists are one step closer to understanding why the critically endangered population of North Atlantic right whales produces so few calves each year.
